reachability_signal: Kernel log shows btmtk init without 'Failed to send wmt func ctrl' error; gcov shows lines 682-683 covered for btmtk.c
expected_signal: btmtk_usb_hci_wmt_sync returns 0 (not -EINVAL) for too-short FUNC_CTRL event; Bluetooth adapter functions normally after init
input_strategy: Connect MT7925 (0e8d:e025) or MT7922 (0489:e0e2) USB BT adapter. The hardware sends short WMT FUNC_CTRL events without status field. The kernel BT stack calls btmtk_usb_hci_wmt_sync during adapter initialization. With the patch, the too-short event is interpreted as BTMTK_WMT_ON_UNDONE and init continues normally.

contract_probe.command: dmesg | grep -c 'Failed to send wmt func ctrl'
contract_probe.before_command: dmesg | grep -c 'Failed to send wmt func ctrl'
contract_probe.after_command: dmesg | grep -c 'Failed to send wmt func ctrl'

limitations: Requires MT7925 (0e8d:e025) or MT7922 (0489:e0e2) USB Bluetooth adapter with specific firmware version. Without hardware, only static code inspection is available. btmtk_usb_hci_wmt_sync depends on full HCI/USB subsystem, so standalone kernel module calling it is impractical without a fully initialized hci_dev.
